description: Edit Markdown as rendered and review AI changes with inline markers. Tables, images, Mermaid, math, front matter and more.
command.textDiff: Open Text Diff with Reviewed Content
view.pending.welcome:
No unreviewed changes.
The first read of each file becomes its baseline; later changes appear here.
config.initialBaseline: What a Markdown file is compared with the first time Markdown Lens sees it.
config.initialBaseline.content: Its current content: only later changes are unreviewed.
config.initialBaseline.gitHead: Its last committed version (Git HEAD): uncommitted changes are unreviewed right away.
config.newFiles: How Markdown files created after monitoring started are treated.
config.newFiles.unreviewed: The whole file is shown as added and unreviewed.
config.newFiles.reviewed: The file starts as reviewed, like an existing file.
config.excludeFolders: Folder names that are not monitored for unreviewed changes.
config.maxFiles: Maximum number of Markdown files monitored in the workspace.
config.maxFileSizeKB: Largest Markdown file (in KB) that can be compared and edited. Larger limits use more memory and CPU.
config.imageFolder: Folder, relative to the Markdown file, where pasted images are saved.
config.pollInterval: How often (ms) a visible preview re-checks its file on disk, in case change notifications are missed. `0` turns this off.
config.editorDecorations: Mark unreviewed changes in the gutter and overview ruler of text editors.
config.statusBar: Show the number of unreviewed changes of the active Markdown file in the status bar.
config.validateLinks: Check relative links, images, heading anchors and wiki links of open previews and report missing targets. External URLs are never requested.
config.math: Render `$…$` and `$$…$$` math with KaTeX. When off, math is shown as source; it is preserved either way.
config.storageRetentionDays: Automatically remove stored review data of files deleted more than this many days ago. `0` keeps it.
